message_text: The windshield wipers I received don't fit my car even though I ordered the size listed on the page. Can you help?
My robot vacuum stopped charging after three weeks. Is this covered under any warranty?
Sorry about that! We can send a replacement unit at no cost - I've started that process, you should get a shipping confirmation within 2 business days.
Got the shipping email, thank you for the quick turnaround!
The toaster oven heats really unevenly - one side browns, the other stays pale. Is this normal or did I get a defective unit?
That's not expected behavior. Could you send us the order number so we can look into a replacement?
Quick question - is this motor oil rated for full synthetic or synthetic blend engines?
It's full synthetic, rated for extended drain intervals. Should work great for your engine.
Getting three different readings in a row from this thermometer. Is there a calibration step I'm missing?
These headphones keep disconnecting from my laptop a few times a day. Any fix before I request a return?
A few customers have hit this with certain Bluetooth drivers - try forgetting the device and re-pairing, that's resolved it for most people.
That worked, thanks for the quick fix!
Is there a smaller wattage version of this toaster oven? Mine keeps tripping my kitchen's circuit when paired with the kettle.
